title: Self-Augmented Diffusion Guidance for Physics-Informed Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models can be used to generate spatiotemporal signals of physical phenomena, such as time-series images of fluid dynamics. However, a major limitation of standard diffusion models is that they do not incorporate constraints derived from the underlying physical laws. Consequently, generated samples may appear visually plausible while deviating substantially from the true dynamics. In this study, we propose a simple yet effective physics-informed approach based on diffusion guidance with self-generated data augmentation. The proposed method learns the data distribution conditioned on the degree of deviation from the physically correct dynamics and generates samples by explicitly setting the deviation condition to be zero. translated_title: 自增强扩散引导用于物理信息生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26748v1 公告类型：新 摘要：扩散模型可用于生成物理现象的时空信号，例如流体动力学的时间序列图像。然而，标准扩散模型的一个主要限制是它们不纳入源自底层物理规律的约束。因此，生成的样本可能表面上看起来合理，但实际与真实动力学存在显著偏差。在本研究中，我们提出了一种简单而有效的基于物理信息的方法，该方法利用自生成数据增强的扩散引导。所提出的方法学习以偏离物理正确动力学的程度为条件的数据分布，并通过将偏离条件明确设置为零来生成样本。该方法将控制方程评估与扩散模型训练和采样过程解耦，避免了在去噪过程的每次迭代中求解控制方程的需求。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自增强扩散引导的物理信息生成方法，通过条件化偏离程度并设为零来确保生成的时空信号符合物理规律，同时避免在去噪过程中反复求解控制方程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-informed generation method using self-augmented diffusion guidance, which conditions on and zeroes the deviation from physical dynamics to ensure generated spatiotemporal signals obey physical laws while avoiding solving governing equations during denoising.
